headline: Canadian Natural Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates as Production Rises
summary: Canadian Natural Resources reported third-quarter earnings above consensus estimates, bolstered by higher realized crude oil prices and total production gains to 1.65 million barrels of oil equivalent per day.
why: Canadian Natural Resources is Canada's largest independent crude oil and natural gas producer.

impacts.name: Canadian Natural Resources
impacts.why: Higher oil output and realized prices delivered an upside beat on quarterly earnings metrics.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger production metrics and an earnings beat supported investor confidence in the energy company.
